notes.title: /*Hello, world!*/
notes.content:
Hello, world!

After months of hard-working as a solo developer, today I’m very proud to announce to you the latest project I’m working on,[b] Overwritten: Defeat The Net[/b]. The game is my take on the card game deckbuilding roguelike. As a big fan of strategy card games, I’ve played a lot of Hearthstone and Slay the Spire, and they are the main inspirations for this game. 

The game is still in very early development, and the next milestone I’m working toward is the closed playtest (and then an open demo).

Since it’s still in early development, your feedback and suggestions will matter a lot. Add the game to your wishlist, follow this Steam page for the latest announcement and join the discord (link below) for suggestions and feedback.
